table.name: TLGNR_SAP_SHIPPING_COND_BS
table.description: Shipping Conditions as distinguished by the LOGON->SAP Order Export Interface. E1=Truck, S1=SBB, S3=Mobile Silos, S4=RhB.

column.name: SAP_SHIPPING_COND_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. Values are defined by SAP. E1=Truck, S1=SBB, S3=Mobile Silos, S4=RhB.

column.name: SEND_TO_SAP_SHIPPING_TYPE
column.description: Used in LOGON->SAP interface for the mapping of shipping condition and shipping type: Shipping CONDITION (VSART): use sap_shipping_cond_bs (no mapping). For Shipping TYPE (ZVSART): use the mapped value send_to_sap_shipping_type.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
